body: This is great, thanks for filing this. FWIW I've added it to my curated list of ["Medium-sized medium priority spec projects"](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Sqx0IH4k1xk5R1_rRHJWGuclu1qj9uDguIrUkTGGtxw/edit) which I haven't publicized too much but it's worth mentioning here maybe.

After #13188, the following remains (generated by GPT-6 Astra Extra High):

### Metadata and resource loading

- [Frozen base URL](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#frozen-base-url): becoming the first `base[href]`, or changing that element’s `href`. Needs explicit insertion, removal, attribute-change, and moving integration.
- [External resource links](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/links.html#linkTypes): implicit link creation and scattered “appropriate times” lists for `dns-prefetch`, `manifest`, `modulepreload`, `preconnect`, `prefetch`, `preload`, and `stylesheet`. These combine connection, attribute changes, and link-type transitions.
- [`link rel=expect`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/links.html#link-type-expect): link creation, browsing-context connection, and `href`/`media` changes still independently trigger processing.
- [`link disabled`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#attr-link-disabled): removal sets *explicitly enabled*; [setting it disables the stylesheet](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/links.html#link-type-stylesheet). These remain separate prose triggers.
- [`meta name=referrer`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#meta-referrer): insertion and `name`/`content` changes trigger policy processing.
- [`meta name=theme-color`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#meta-theme-color) and [`color-scheme`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#meta-color-scheme): insertion, removal, and attribute changes trigger recomputation; theme color additionally responds to media-environment changes.
- [`meta http-equiv`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#pragma-directives): insertion dispatches to the appropriate pragma algorithm.
- [Updating a `style` block](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#update-a-style-block): connection, disconnection, children changes, and parser completion remain collected in a separate trigger list.
- [`embed`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#concept-embed-active): becoming/stopping being *potentially active*, plus `src`/`type` mutations. Activity combines tree position, document activity, rendering, and ancestor fallback state.
- [`object`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#the-object-element): a combined trigger list covers creation, parser completion, insertion/removal, document activity, ancestor fallback, rendering, and `classid`/`data`/`type` changes.

### Media

- [Media resource URL resolution](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#concept-media-load-algorithm): both media-element and child-`source` URLs refer back to the document when `src` was last changed, without explicitly capturing the necessary state at mutation time.
- [Media source-selection bookkeeping](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#concept-media-load-algorithm): insertion/removal/moving update a local traversal pointer and candidate from inside the resource-selection algorithm. The DOM hooks are referenced, but processing remains scattered.
- [Media removal](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#playing-the-media-resource): removal from a document triggers a stable-state check and potentially pauses playback.
- [`track` reparenting](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks): parent changes update track membership, queue `addtrack`/`removetrack`, and start processing. [Pending-track cleanup](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#list-of-pending-text-tracks) has another parent-change trigger.

### Controls and shared processing

- [Radio-button exclusivity](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#radio-button-state-(type=radio)): checkedness, `name`, form-owner changes, signalled type changes, and connection all feed a separate trigger list.
- [Range-value correction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#range-state-(type=range)): underflow, overflow, and step mismatch cause value changes, without explicit sequencing for mutations that change those constraints.
- [Image-button loading](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#image-button-state-(type=image)): `src` changes and entering/re-entering the Image Button state, including historical comparisons against the previous visit to that state.
- [Microdata URL values](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/microdata.html#concept-property-value): `src`/`href`/`data` URLs are resolved “at the time the attribute is set”, without explicit stored state or mutation steps.
- [Nonce hiding](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#attr-nonce): browsing-context connection triggers hiding separately from the now-centralized attribute processing.
- [Render-blocking cleanup](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#render-blocking-mechanism): browsing-context disconnection still triggers unblocking separately. This also covers loss of the document’s browsing context, not just removal.
- [Autofocus](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#attr-fe-autofocus): insertion into a document triggers candidate registration.
- [FACE disabledness reactions](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/custom-elements.html#custom-element-reactions): the callback overview describes disabled-state changes, but explicit mutation-triggered reaction enqueueing remains missing for `disabled`, fieldset ancestry, and first-legend changes.

### Related cases requiring different treatment

- [Stylesheet `media`/`title` synchronization](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#css-style-sheets): HTML delegates through live attribute references; CSSOM contains the mutation-triggered updates. Consolidation needs cross-spec coordination.
- [Canvas dimensions](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#attr-canvas-width): the placeholder-mode exception still intercepts attribute setting before mutation, so it cannot simply become an attribute-change step. No-context bitmap sizing also remains expressed as an invariant.
- [Image environment updates](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/images.html#reacting-to-environment-changes) and [script prefetching](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#prepare-a-script): insertion/attribute-related advice or permissions remain, but these are not missing mandatory hook invocations.

For `moveBefore()`, this needs feature-specific decisions—not blanket insertion/removal replay. Base-element precedence demonstrably depends on reordering; first-match metadata and radio-group changes also deserve explicit treatment.
